title: Content calendar
summary: Drafts cited posts from your topics and sources in your house style, and publishes only what a person approves.

inspiration.title: Multi-platform social content creation with AI
Personalized AI tech newsletter (RSS, OpenAI, Gmail)
Write a WordPress post with AI from keywords
SEO WordPress content with Perplexity research

stages.title: Research topics
stages.does: Reads the feeds and searches each topic, keeping every source URL.

stages.title: Draft posts
stages.does: Drafts each post in each format in the house style, with a marker per claim.

stages.title: Check citations
stages.does: Checks every citation marker has a source and every source is cited.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

stages.title: Approve each post
stages.does: A person approves, edits or declines each draft; the gate times out after 72 hours.

stages.title: Publish approved posts
stages.does: On a later run, publishes only the drafts whose decision is approved, exactly as approved.

connectors.label: Web search
connectors.purpose: Find recent material on each topic.
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run already has web search; check it does before the first run.

connectors.label: Web fetch
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run can already open web pages.

connectors.label: Mail for approvals
connectors.purpose: Carry each approval request for a draft post.
connectors.connect: Add a mail connector to the routine's environment before you turn gated messages on.

connectors.label: Publishing platform
connectors.purpose: Publish a post a person approved.
alternatives: Copy the approved draft by hand from the Desk
connectors.connect: Add an MCP server or connector for your blog or social platform with publish access, only when you are ready for approved posts to go out.
